findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

Observed raw shell eggs above ready-to-eat foods (grapes). Ensure eggs stay below RTE items to prevent against cross contamination. Inspector moved the eggs to the same level as the grapes (nothing on shelf below). Discuss with staff to ensure they are aware of appropriate storage order. Storage order placement of foods infographic is available in the kitchen manager’s office (taped to the side of the filing cabinet). Discussed with PIC. PIC indicated she would review storage order with staff. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the interior baffle of the ice machine in the kitchen to have a layer of mildew and mold upon wiping with paper towel. Mold was visible, as well. Discussed routine cleaning of the interior of the ice machine with PIC. PIC instructed employees to begin removing the ice from the ice machine and wash, rinsing, and sanitizing the interior of the machine. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The bucket of sanitizer used in the kitchen is observed to barely register a color change on the inspector’s or facility’s test strips. This indicated a concentration in the double digits when 200 ppm is the minimum for quat. Food handling/ preparation was taking place at this time and this is the only bucket observed in this area. The bucket was remade to correct.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment: 3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. A can of corn is observed with a significant dent in the upper rim. A conversation took place in relation to dangerous areas for a dent to be located, and the can was moved by the PIC to a donation location. Food program supervisor for the school system (Chad) donates damaged cans of unopened foods from the schools.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11 (C) (C) Non FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

Mold was observed on the outer surface of a container of worshire sauce in the walk in cooler. The PIC was notified of the issue and the container was cleaned during the inspection to correct. No mold was observed on surrounding containers or inside of the effected container.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15  (Pf) Food packaging on containers of beef and chicken base have mold growing on the outside of the containers. Food packaging must be in good condition so that foods are not exposed to adulteration or potential contamination. The containers were discarded during the inspection.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

Observed chemicals stored above where the clean dishes come out of the dish machine. This poses a potential for contaminating food contact surfaces. Discussed with the person in charge and the items were moved during the inspection.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment: 750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption. Observed 4 containers in the walk in cooler that has colonies of mold growing on them. Showed them to the PIC and they were promptly discarded.

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.comment: 750-530a Employees shall consume food only in designated dining areas. An employee dining area shall not be so designated if consuming food there may result in contamination of other food, equipment, utensils, or other items needing protection. Observed one employee drinking from a bottle of water in the dish cleaning room. Discussed with PIC about keeping personal items and consumables in designated areas and separate from sections involved in clean storage or mixed with other consumables for public dispersion.

findings.title: Sanitizing temperature
findings.comment:
Observed the dish machine heat sanitizer to read 0F. Repair the dish machine. The manager stated that a part for the dish machine has been ordered. A follow-up will be made to ensure the dish machine is operating correctly.
750-830 All hot water for sanitizing dishes and equipment must be a minimum of 180F when it leaves the dish washing machine manifold in order to kill pathogens.  Properly sanitize all items. Check and maintain the dishwasher frequently.  The facility will be sanitizing there dishes in the three compartment sink until the part comes.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 750-250 One of two milk coolers is observed with milk at temperatures from 44F to 53F. Multiple milks from all crates were probed. Milks under 45F were allowed to be kept, those 45 and over were discarded. Temperature log is available. The log indicated that the temperatures in the two milk coolers were 50F and 43 on 1/25/17. Certified manager should be aware that the cold holding temperature is 41F and that service should be requested for units not maintaining that temperature. Prairie Farms was contacted during the inspection and will be responded to service on 1/27/17.   All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 41°F or below while on display and service.

findings.title: Facilities to maintain proper temperatures
findings.comment: 750-140 See notes in violation #3a. The milk cooler on the west side of the cafeteria is not properly holding milk at 41F or below. Multiple milks were discarded. Prairie Farms has been contacted and will respond to service tomorrow morning (1/27/17). The milk will be stored in the walk-in cooler after lunch service, however, the cooler should be repaired quickly so that milk does not have to sit at inappropriate temperatures between breakfast and lunch.  All refrigeration units used to store potentially hazardous foods shall be able to maintain proper product temperature at 41°F or below.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: 750-120(a) Observed the brown rice package to be used as labeling/serving instructions in the bulk brown rice container. The exterior of the rice package is in direct contact with the food. You cannot guarantee the outside of any container is clean and free of debris and filth. Cease storing exterior packaging in contact with food. Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
Observed two severe dented cans of red sauce stored on the shelves for use.  The manager removed them from the shelf an stored them in her office for credit.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed two spatulas that were chipping.  The spatulas were removed from the food service area. IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED.
750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1)Observed the floor underneath the ice machine to be soiled.  2) Observed the floor in the dry storage area to have some debris accumulation.  Clean the floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed single service items intermixed in lunch line.  Spoons were placed into circular containers to have handle extended out of the food.  IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.
